component.name: Transume
component.summary: Back up, restore, and clone storage devices

description.p: Transume provides a graphical interface for Clonezilla backup, restoration, direct cloning, image management, and verification workflows.

The name Transume comes from a historical English verb used for making an official copy or extract of a document, and for attesting that a copy matched its source. The application brings that idea to disks by preserving a system's structure and contents in a form that can be checked, restored, or cloned.
The graphical application remains unprivileged and requests authorization only when a storage operation requires elevated privileges.
Local and network repositories, read-only image exploration, explicit partition restore, and Clonezilla LVM2 images are supported.
